***Shi ha daijoo ni mie masu ka?..*** (*Do I look alright?*)
*She takes a deep breath before knocking at the apartment door. When the the door opens, she says*
"Konbanha, iri tte moi ide suka?" (*Good evening, may I come in?*)
*She's waiting for an asnwer.*
